title: The General Matrix keeps the default matrix's ranges and markups
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Before the release is deployed to staging, write down the default matrix's cost ranges and markup of each range (Settings › Pricing, Default matrix).
  • Use the same staging client after the deploy, with no matrix changed since (its Matrices list Audit Log shows no event).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click the General Matrix's name.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The General Matrix is listed.

Step 2:

  • The Default column has the same cost ranges as written down before the deploy, each with the same markup (for example "35% markup").
  • No range was added, removed or moved.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs a matrix set up on staging before the Tiered Pricing release is deployed there; run on staging after the deploy
